task: Exact Gaussian-process regression, full train-and-predict pipeline with posterior mean and latent variance

data.source: declared synthetic spatial regression, not a real-world or general neural-network benchmark
data.training_inputs: complete Cartesian product of linspace(0,1,n_i), endpoint included, C-order flattening
data.test_seed: 10000+seed, independent continuous-uniform test coordinates and independent observation noise
data.normalization: subtract training-target mean only; identical baseline and method

kernel.hyperparameters: fixed in advance; no search or test tuning

baseline.name: dense_cholesky
baseline.fit: build the exact dense covariance from Kronecker kernel factors, add noise variance, SciPy LAPACK Cholesky and cho_solve; no inverse
baseline.predict: cross covariance, dense mean GEMV and one batched solve_triangular for all test points, variance via squared triangular solutions

method.name: tensor_spectral
method.fit: full per-axis float64 symmetric eigendecomposition, tensor transform, exact division by eigenvalue products plus noise
method.predict: off-grid tensor contractions for mean and exact latent variance; no low-rank truncation

quality.primary_metric: RMSE against held-out noisy test targets
quality.pass_rule: method RMSE <= paired dense RMSE + tolerance AND all guardrails pass for every primary seed and repetition

timing.primary: cold subprocess wall-clock from spawn through exit, including interpreter startup, numerical imports, input NPZ load, training-only centering, kernel construction, fit, off-grid mean+variance prediction, test metrics and prediction output NPZ+JSON serialization
timing.secondary: internal load-to-output pipeline clock and per-stage times; explicitly exclude interpreter/import time only in this secondary metric
timing.excluded_once_per_experiment: dependency installation, deterministic fixture generation, reference validation and report aggregation; shared by baseline and method
timing.pair_order: balanced deterministic randomized order from seed 20261017, no overlapping timed processes
timing.speedup: sum of all baseline cold wall times divided by sum of all method cold wall times, with every run retained
timing.uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap resampling the five dataset seeds, 10000 replicates, percentile 95% interval; also report raw min/max and median

additional_checks: small-grid independent scikit-learn GaussianProcessRegressor reference with optimizer=None and identical hyperparameters
grid-size scaling including smaller problems where startup may dominate
query-count and variance-versus-mean-only ablations, labeled separately
noise/conditioning, lengthscale and missing-grid robustness studies, not pooled with primary results
tensor residual and nonnegative variance tests

honesty.primary_if_resources_fail: report failure; do not silently replace primary size or endpoint
